newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas ends with a whimper in quiet afternoon.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas ends with a whimper in quiet afternoon.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market closed the week on a quiet note, with only a single trade done on Friday afternoon on top of the three deals done in the morning session.

There was a single March 1998 trade done for 25 lots at 13.95 pence a therm, down by 0.105 pence a therm from the previous settlement price. Otherwise no activity was seen at all in the afternoon session. Only 85 lots were traded over the day.
"The overall gas market is a little bit on the dead side," said a futures broker, adding that the OTC market as well as the futures market had recently been quiet.

He pointed out that following a couple of busy days last week, some players had hoped the futures market was picking up, but this week activity slipped back and trade had generally been disappointing.

Front month May settled at 10.225 pence a therm, down by 0.025 pence on the day. June and July settled up slightly, but all other months from August to next April closed down by between 0.025 and 0.105 pence a therm.
